data.current_description:
Changes the [status of an account holder](https://docs.adyen.com/classic-platforms/account-holders-and-accounts#account-holder-statuses) from **Suspended** to **Inactive**. 
Account holders can have a **Suspended** [`status`](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/#/Account/latest/post/getAccountHolder__resParam_verification-accountHolder-checks-status) if you suspend them through the [`/suspendAccountHolder`](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/#/Account/v5/post/suspendAccountHolder) endpoint or if a verification deadline expires.

You can only unsuspend account holders if they do not have verification checks with a **FAILED** [`status`](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/#/Account/latest/post/getAccountHolder__resParam_verification-accountHolder-checks-status).
data.description_suggestion: Changes the status of an account holder from **Suspended** to **Inactive**, restoring their account operations. Requires the account holder identifier in the request. Can only be executed if the account holder has no verification checks with **FAILED** status. Returns the updated account holder status and verification details. Account holders become suspended through the `/suspendAccountHolder` endpoint or when verification deadlines expire.
data.reasoning: While the description provides good context about prerequisites and suspension causes, it lacks clarity on required inputs and response structure. Reorganized for better AI agent understanding by clearly stating: what input is needed, preconditions for success, what is returned, and when suspension occurs.

If payments are made to an account of an account holder with a **Closed** [`status`](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/#/Account/latest/post/getAccountHolder__resParam_verification-accountHolder-checks-status), the payments are sent to your liable account.
data.description_suggestion: Sets an account holder's status to Closed, a permanent and irreversible state. Side effects: all associated accounts become inactive, transactions cannot be processed, funds cannot be paid out, and the account holder cannot be reopened. Payments received after closure are routed to your liable account. Returns the updated account holder status and verification details. This operation affects all accounts under the account holder.
data.reasoning: Summary is clear. Description contains relevant information but is verbose and unclear about scope (affects all accounts). Improved version clarifies that this is a permanent state change affecting all associated accounts, explicitly lists side effects, and specifies return values for AI agent understanding.
